target.purpose: Bind edge-agent authority to request-scoped capability tokens that can be delegated only by attenuation with explicit provenance.
target.central_bottleneck: Flat capability tokens prevent in-place escalation but do not prove how bounded authority moves across worker hops, and delimiter-framed signatures can make structurally different capability sets ambiguous.

invariants: signed token structure uses canonical JSON with cross-runtime microsecond time normalization
a delegated child must bind a verified parent fingerprint and depth+1 provenance
child capabilities cannot exceed the parent capability set
child validity cannot expand beyond the parent validity window
child request identity must differ from the parent request identity
tampered child content or wrong-parent verification fails closed
delegation produces a deterministic receipt without mutating parent authority
nonclaims: not a production Workers authorization service
issuer identity is a local shared-secret authority rather than externally rooted identity
